title: Hermit[RUS]
description: In this mod, you will be greeted by an NPC, he was created to remove loneliness from people, but is this really true?
body:
#  **ATTENTION**

**This mod contains unpleasant scenes and loud sounds. It is not recommended for people with any disorders, heart problems, or people under 18 years of age to play.**

**The mod contains two videos, in Event 2 and Event 3. Wallpaper changes in all events. Install the mod at your own risk.**

##     **STORY**

One day, when you felt lonely, you didn't know how to get rid of it, but suddenly, you saw an advertisement on the Internet with a mod that gets rid of loneliness, you decided to download this mod, but something went wrong.

###   Details
- 3 Events
- 5 Micro-events
- The mod takes 1 hour to complete.

**The idea of ​​the mod itself was inspired by other mods such as:Inside the system ,The broken script.**


**This mod contains only Russian language.**


**This mod adds a creepy creature that will scare you for 1 hour.**

**The evil version is another side of the NPC's personality that becomes dangerous. The version itself appears when you don't answer his questions for 3 days or send him away.**

## Event
**1 Event - adds a riddle that the player/players must solve within 3 minutes. If the riddle is not solved, the world will be deleted. The event itself appears after 10 minutes when the NPC has switched to an evil version.**

**2 Event - scary music starts and the player must run away from the monster; if he doesn't run away, the world is deleted and the wallpaper changes, turning on a scary video. The event itself starts after the 1st event, 20 minutes later.**

### Boss Fight

**Event 3 is the final event where you'll be transported to another dimension for a boss fight. This boss has 3 waves of attacks and 750 HP. The event starts 30 minutes after Event 2. If you lose the event or don't finish him off, the world is deleted, the wallpaper changes, and a scary video is turned on.**

**Wave 1 - zombies and wither skeletons will spawn, there will be 30 of them in total, and when the player kills them, another 30 mobs will spawn, followed by another 30, for a total of 90 mobs spawned in wave 1**

**Wave 2 - Anvils and arrows will spawn from the sky for 30 seconds.**

**Wave 3 - will be the last in this wave, the monster will release a wither head at you**

## Micro-Events

1 Micro Event-a monster appears behind the player; if the player turns around, a screamer appears.

2 Micro Event-a monster appears in the distance; if you look at it, it will disappear.

3 Micro Event-a sign will appear in front of the player with the inscription of his Windows profile name

4 Micro Event-a screamer appears

5 Micro Event-scary music appears for 30 seconds
